fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(12,8),sharey=True)
for ax,project in zip(axes.flat,('OWASP','conductor','thingsboard','Stirling-PDF')):
 for label,color,name in(('saved-default','#3366aa','Saved default'),('heap16g','#dd7722','16 GiB')):
  row=next(r for r in payload['datasets']if r['project']==project and r['label']==label)

  with Path(row['csv']['GC']).open()as f:gs=[r for r in csv.DictReader(f)if r['kind'].startswith(('Pause Young','Pause Full'))]
  ax.plot([float(r['elapsed'])/60 for r in rs],[int(r['rss'])/2**30 for r in rs],color=color,linestyle='--',linewidth=.9,alpha=.6,label=name+' RSS')
  ax.plot([float(r['elapsed_approx'])/60 for r in gs],[int(r['after_bytes_rounded'])/2**30 for r in gs],color=color,linewidth=.8,label=name+' after young/full GC')
 ax.set_title(project);ax.set_xlabel('Minutes from project launch');ax.set_ylabel('GiB');ax.set_ylim(bottom=0);ax.grid(alpha=.2)
